title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Strikes 023 — Detached Threat Impact / Clock Fork Debt

tango_history.judgment: Release is body-earned through K01-K03; K04-K06 split launcher recoil/support catch from continuing detached-threat travel; K06 establishes threat precontact only after support changed; K07-K08 hold the threat at the same impact point while root, shoulders, and rear-leg recovery continue; K09-K12 pay separate overshoot, secondary lag, rear-support reacquisition, and displaced settle without reverse interpolation.

noodle_queen_final.taste: The useful oddity is the argument between clocks: the projectile gets its tiny dramatic freeze while the launcher refuses to pose for it.
noodle_queen_final.function: Release, body overrun, threat travel, body support catch, threat precontact, threat-local impact hold, impact break, shoulder lag, and displaced two-support recovery are distinct authored states.
noodle_queen_final.contempt: Rejects the cheap global-freeze trick and the equally cheap rewind-to-launch-pose recovery; the detached hit is allowed to be late and the body still has bills to pay.

principle.name: DETACHED_THREAT_IMPACT_CLOCK_FORK_DEBT
principle.pocket_rule: THE BODY FIRES THE THREAT AND STARTS TO LEAVE; THE HIT ARRIVES ON ANOTHER CLOCK. IMPACT CANNOT REWIND THE LAUNCHER.
principle.fresh_interpretation: Release forks one authored action into two clocks. The launcher spends rear-support drive, releases the threat, then begins recoil and support re-entry while the detached threat continues independently. Threat precontact and impact occur only after the body has already changed support and recovery state. A short threat-local contact hold does not freeze or rewind the launcher. Recovery still owes shoulder/arm lag, root settling, and late rear-support reacquisition at a displaced address.

compile.transition_policy: authored holds plus deterministic one-frame geometry connectors only when support/contact/threat topology is unchanged; connectors may not invent release, support, contact, threat impact, or causal state
